040/**
041 * Session object that lives for the duration of a single use of {@link RdfStreamParser}.
042 *
043 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
044 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe and is typically discarded after one use.
045 * </ul>
046 *
047 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
048 *    <li class='link'>{doc jmr.RdfDetails}
049 * </ul>
050 */
051@SuppressWarnings({
052   "unchecked",   // Type erasure requires unchecked casts
053   "rawtypes",    // Raw types necessary for generic type handling
054   "java:S115",   // Constants use naming conventions that embed type info or config keys (e.g. PROP_collectionFormat)
055   "java:S3776",  // Cognitive complexity acceptable for RDF stream parser state machine methods
056   "java:S6541"   // Brain Method complexity acceptable for core RDF stream parser dispatch logic
057})
058public class RdfStreamParserSession extends InputStreamParserSession {
059

077         super(assertArgNotNull(ARG_ctx, ctx));
078         this.ctx = ctx;
079      }
080
081      @Override

086   }

099   private final Model model;
100   private final org.apache.jena.rdf.model.Property pRoot;
101   private final org.apache.jena.rdf.model.Property pValue;
102   private final org.apache.jena.rdf.model.Property pType;
103   private final org.apache.jena.rdf.model.Property pRdfType;
104   private final Lang lang;
105   private final RdfStreamParser ctx;
106   private final Set<Resource> urisVisited = st();

108   /**
109    * Constructor.
110    *
111    * @param builder The builder for this object.
112    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
113    */
114   protected RdfStreamParserSession(Builder builder) {
115      super(builder);
116      ctx = builder.ctx;
117      model = ModelFactory.createDefaultModel();
118      addModelPrefix(ctx.getJuneauNs());
119      addModelPrefix(ctx.getJuneauBpNs());
120      pRdfType = model.createProperty("http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type");
121      pRoot = model.createProperty(ctx.getJuneauNs().getUri(), RDF_juneauNs_ROOT);
122      pType = model.createProperty(ctx.getJuneauBpNs().getUri(), RDF_juneauNs_TYPE);
123      pValue = model.createProperty(ctx.getJuneauNs().getUri(), RDF_juneauNs_VALUE);
124
125      // Map legacy language names to RIOT Lang
126      var langName = ctx.getLanguage();
127      lang = toLang(langName);
128      if (lang == null)
129         throw isex("Unknown RDF language: %s", langName);
130   }

132   @Override /* InputStreamParserSession */
133   public boolean hasNativeBytes() {
134      // The RDF graph layer has no native byte-array literal type — byte[] is surfaced either as an
135      // xsd:base64Binary typed literal (at BinaryFormat.NOT_SET) or as a plain string literal
136      // carrying the configured BinaryFormat's text wire form (at any other BinaryFormat; BinarySwap fires
137      // to reverse the wire form back to byte[]).
138      return false;
139   }

141   private static Lang toLang(String langName) {
142      var lang = RDFLanguages.nameToLang(langName);
143      if (lang != null)
144         return lang;
145      if ("RDF/PROTO".equals(langName)) // HTT - not registered in Jena's RDFLanguages
146         return Lang.RDFPROTO;
147      return null;
148   }
149
150   private void addModelPrefix(Namespace ns) {
151      model.setNsPrefix(ns.getName(), ns.getUri());
152   }
153
154   /*
155    * Decodes the specified string.
156    * If {@link RdfStreamParser#isTrimWhitespace} is <jk>true</jk>, the resulting string is trimmed before decoding.
157    * If {@link #isTrimStrings()} is <jk>true</jk>, the resulting string is trimmed after decoding.
158    */
159   String decodeString(Object o) {
160      if (o == null)
161         return null;
162      var s = o.toString();
163      if (s.isEmpty())
164         return s;
165      if (isTrimWhitespace()) // HTT: RdfStreamParser.Builder only exposes language(); trimWhitespace is always false for stream parsers.
166         s = s.trim(); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
167      s = XmlUtils.decode(s, null);
168      if (isTrimStrings())
169         s = s.trim();
170      return s;
171   }
172
173   /*
174    * Finds the roots in the model using either the "root" property to identify it,
175    *    or by resorting to scanning the model for all nodes with no incoming predicates.
176    */
177   List<Resource> getRoots(Model m) {
178      var l = new LinkedList<Resource>();
179
180      // First try to find the root using the "http://www.apache.org/juneau/root" property.
181      var root = m.createProperty(getJuneauNs().getUri(), RDF_juneauNs_ROOT);
182      for (ResIterator i = m.listResourcesWithProperty(root); i.hasNext();)
183         l.add(i.next());
184
185      if (! l.isEmpty())
186         return l;
187
188      // Otherwise, we need to find all resources that aren't objects.
189      // We want to explicitly ignore statements where the subject
190      // and object are the same node.
191      var objects = new HashSet<RDFNode>();
192      for (StmtIterator i = m.listStatements(); i.hasNext();) {
193         var st = i.next();
194         var subject = st.getSubject();
195         var object = st.getObject();
196         if (object.isResource() && ! object.equals(subject))
197            objects.add(object);
198      }
199      for (ResIterator i = m.listSubjects(); i.hasNext();) {
200         var r = i.next();
201         if (! objects.contains(r))
202            l.add(r);
203      }
204      return l;
205   }
206
207   Object getValue(RDFNode n, Object outer) throws ParseException {
208      if (n.isLiteral())
209         return n.asLiteral().getValue();
210      if (n.isResource()) { // HTT: RDFNode has only two concrete kinds (Literal, Resource); this is always true once isLiteral() is false.
211         var st = n.asResource().getProperty(pValue);
212         if (nn(st)) {
213            n = st.getObject();
214            if (n.isLiteral())
215               return n.asLiteral().getValue();
216            return readAnything(object(), st.getObject(), outer, null);
217         }
218      }
219      throw new ParseException(this, "Unknown value type for node '%s'", n);
220   }
221
222   boolean isBag(RDFNode n) {
223      if (n.isResource()) {
224         var st = n.asResource().getProperty(pRdfType);
225         if (nn(st))
226            return RDF_BAG.equals(st.getResource().getURI());
227      }
228      return false;
229   }
230
231   boolean isMultiValuedCollections(BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) {
232      var bpRdf = (pMeta == null ? RdfBeanPropertyMeta.DEFAULT : getRdfBeanPropertyMeta(pMeta));
233
234      if (bpRdf.getCollectionFormat() != RdfCollectionFormat.DEFAULT)
235         return bpRdf.getCollectionFormat() == RdfCollectionFormat.MULTI_VALUED;
236
237      return getCollectionFormat() == RdfCollectionFormat.MULTI_VALUED; // HTT: RdfStreamParser.Builder only exposes language(); the global collection format is always DEFAULT (never MULTI_VALUED) for stream parsers.
238   }
239
240   boolean isSeq(RDFNode n) {
241      if (n.isResource()) {
242         var st = n.asResource().getProperty(pRdfType);
243         if (nn(st))
244            return RDF_SEQ.equals(st.getResource().getURI());
245      }
246      return false;
247   }
248
249   <T> T readAnything(ClassMeta<?> eType, RDFNode n, Object outer, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
250
251      if (eType == null)
252         eType = object();
253      var swap = (ObjectSwap<T,Object>)eType.getSwap(this);
254      var builder = (BuilderSwap<T,Object>)eType.getBuilderSwap(this);
255      ClassMeta<?> sType;
256      if (nn(builder))
257         sType = builder.getBuilderClassMeta(this);
258      else if (nn(swap))
259         sType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
260      else
261         sType = eType;
262
263      if (sType.isOptional())
264         return (T)o(readAnything(eType.getElementType(), n, outer, pMeta));
265
266      setCurrentClass(sType);
267
268      if (! sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) && n.isResource()) {
269         var st = n.asResource().getProperty(pType);
270         if (nn(st)) {
271            var c = st.getLiteral().getString();
272            var tcm = getClassMeta(c, pMeta, eType);
273            if (nn(tcm))
274               sType = eType = tcm;
275         }
276      }
277
278      Object o = null;
279      if (n.isResource() && nn(n.asResource().getURI()) && n.asResource().getURI().equals(RDF_NIL)) {
280         // Do nothing.  Leave o == null.
281      } else if (sType.isObject()) {
282         if (n.isLiteral()) {
283            o = n.asLiteral().getValue();
284            if (o instanceof String o2) {
285               o = decodeString(o2);
286            }
287         } else if (n.isResource()) { // HTT: RDFNode has only two concrete kinds (Literal, Resource); this is always true once isLiteral() (above) is false — the else below is defensive dead code.
288            var r = n.asResource();
289            if (! urisVisited.add(r))
290               o = r.getURI();
291            else if (nn(r.getProperty(pValue))) {
292               o = readAnything(object(), n.asResource().getProperty(pValue).getObject(), outer, null);
293            } else if (isSeq(r)) {
294               o = new JsonList(this);
295               readIntoCollection(r.as(Seq.class), (Collection)o, sType, pMeta);
296            } else if (isBag(r)) {
297               o = new JsonList(this);
298               readIntoCollection(r.as(Bag.class), (Collection)o, sType, pMeta);
299            } else if (r.canAs(RDFList.class)) {
300               o = new JsonList(this);
301               readIntoCollection(r.as(RDFList.class), (Collection)o, sType, pMeta);
302            } else {
303               // If it has a URI and no child properties, we interpret this as an
304               // external resource, and convert it to just a URL.
305               var uri = r.getURI();
306               if (nn(uri) && ! r.listProperties().hasNext()) {
307                  o = r.getURI();
308               } else {
309                  var m2 = new JsonMap(this);
310                  readIntoMap(r, m2, null, null, pMeta);
311                  o = cast(m2, pMeta, eType);
312               }
313            }
314         } else {
315            throw new ParseException(this, "Unrecognized node type '%s' for object", n); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above; n is always Literal or Resource.
316         }
317      } else if (nn(builder)) {
318         var r = n.asResource();
319         if (! urisVisited.add(r))
320            return null;
321         var bm = toBeanMap(builder.create(this, eType));
322         o = builder.build(this, readIntoBeanMap(r, bm).getBean(), eType);
323      } else if (sType.canCreateNewBean(outer)) {
324         var r = n.asResource();
325         if (! urisVisited.add(r))
326            return null;
327         var bm = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner());
328         o = readIntoBeanMap(r, bm).getBean();
329      } else if (sType.isMap()) {
330         var r = n.asResource();
331         if (! urisVisited.add(r))
332            return null;
333         var m = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Map)sType.newInstance(outer) : newGenericMap(sType));
334         o = readIntoMap(r, m, eType.getKeyType(), eType.getValueType(), pMeta);
335      } else if (sType.isByteArray()) {
336         // Correctness gate: byte[] satisfies isArray()/isCollectionOrArray() too, but RDF emits
337         // byte[] as a typed base64 literal (not as a Seq/Bag/RDFList of byte resources).  This
338         // branch MUST stay above isCollectionOrArray so the literal path fires first.
339         var v = getValue(n, outer);
340         if (v instanceof byte[] b) {
341            o = b;
342         } else if (v != null) {
343            o = Base64.getDecoder().decode(v.toString());
344         }
345      } else if (sType.isCollectionOrArray() || sType.isArgs()) { // HTT: isArgs() requires method-argument list ClassMeta; not reachable through public parse() API — always false here.
346         if (sType.isArray() || sType.isArgs()) // HTT: isArgs() requires method-argument list ClassMeta; not reachable through public parse() API — always false here.
347            o = list();
348         else
349            o = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Collection<?>)sType.newInstance(outer) : new JsonList(this));
350         var r = n.asResource();
351         if (! urisVisited.add(r))
352            return null;
353         if (isSeq(r)) {
354            readIntoCollection(r.as(Seq.class), (Collection)o, sType, pMeta);
355         } else if (isBag(r)) {
356            readIntoCollection(r.as(Bag.class), (Collection)o, sType, pMeta);
357         } else if (r.canAs(RDFList.class)) {
358            readIntoCollection(r.as(RDFList.class), (Collection)o, sType, pMeta);
359         } else {
360            throw new ParseException(this, "Unrecognized node type '%s' for collection", n);
361         }
362         if (sType.isArray() || sType.isArgs()) // HTT: isArgs() requires method-argument list ClassMeta; not reachable through public parse() API — always false here.
363            o = toArray(sType, (Collection)o);
364      } else if (sType.isCharSequence()) {
365         o = decodeString(getValue(n, outer));
366      } else if (sType.isChar()) {
367         o = parseCharacter(decodeString(getValue(n, outer)));
368      } else if (sType.isNumber()) {
369         o = parseNumber(getValue(n, outer).toString(), (Class<? extends Number>)sType.inner());
370      } else if (sType.isBoolean()) {
371         o = convertToType(getValue(n, outer), boolean.class);
372      } else if (sType.isUri() && n.isResource()) {
373         // RDF URIs must be reconstructed from the resource's URI string (not from a literal),
374         // so this branch is kept here to fire before the temporal/scalar coercion fallbacks.
375         o = sType.newInstanceFromString(outer, decodeString(n.asResource().getURI()));
376      } else if (sType.isDate()) {
377         o = readDate(getValue(n, outer).toString(), sType);
378      } else if (sType.isCalendar()) {
379         o = readCalendar(getValue(n, outer).toString(), sType);
380      } else if (sType.isTemporal()) {
381         o = readTemporal(getValue(n, outer).toString(), sType);
382      } else if (sType.isDuration()) {
383         o = readDuration(getValue(n, outer).toString());
384      } else if (sType.isPeriod()) {
385         o = readPeriod(getValue(n, outer).toString());
386      } else if (sType.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(outer)) {
387         o = sType.newInstanceFromString(outer, decodeString(getValue(n, outer)));
388      } else if (n.isResource()) {
389         var r = n.asResource();
390         var m = newGenericMap(sType);
391         readIntoMap(r, m, sType.getKeyType(), sType.getValueType(), pMeta);
392         if (m.containsKey(getBeanTypePropertyName(eType)))
393            o = cast((MarshalledMap)m, pMeta, eType);
394         else if (nn(sType.getProxyInvocationHandler()))
395            o = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner()).load(m).getBean();
396         else
397            throw new ParseException(this, "Class '%s' could not be instantiated.  Reason: '%s'", cn(sType), sType.getNotABeanReason());
398      } else {
399         throw new ParseException(this, "Class '%s' could not be instantiated.  Reason: '%s'", cn(sType), sType.getNotABeanReason());
400      }
401
402      if (nn(swap) && nn(o))
403         o = unswap(swap, o, eType);
404
405      if (nn(outer))
406         setParent(eType, o, outer);
407
408      return (T)o;
409   }
410
411   <T> BeanMap<T> readIntoBeanMap(Resource r2, BeanMap<T> m) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
412      var bm = m.getMeta();
413      var rbm = getRdfBeanMeta(bm);
414      if (rbm.hasBeanUri() && nn(r2.getURI()))
415         rbm.getBeanUriProperty().set(m, null, r2.getURI());
416      for (StmtIterator i = r2.listProperties(); i.hasNext();) {
417         var st = i.next();
418         var p = st.getPredicate();
419         var key = decodeString(p.getLocalName());
420         var pMeta = m.getPropertyMeta(key);
421         setCurrentProperty(pMeta);
422         if (nn(pMeta)) {
423            var o = st.getObject();
424            var cm = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
425            if (cm.isCollectionOrArray() && isMultiValuedCollections(pMeta)) {
426               var et = cm.getElementType();
427               var value = readAnything(et, o, m.getBean(false), pMeta);
428               setName(et, value, key);
429               try {
430                  pMeta.add(m, key, value);
431               } catch (BeanRuntimeException e) {
432                  onBeanSetterException(pMeta, e);
433                  throw e;
434               }
435            } else {
436               var value = readAnything(cm, o, m.getBean(false), pMeta);
437               setName(cm, value, key);
438               try {
439                  pMeta.set(m, key, value);
440               } catch (BeanRuntimeException e) {
441                  onBeanSetterException(pMeta, e);
442                  throw e;
443               }
444            }
445         } else if (! (p.equals(pRoot) || p.equals(pType))) {
446            var o = st.getObject();
447            var value = readAnything(object(), o, m.getBean(false), null);
448            onUnknownProperty(key, m, value);
449         }
450         setCurrentProperty(null);
451      }
452      return m;
453   }
454
455   <E> Collection<E> readIntoCollection(Container c, Collection<E> l, ClassMeta<?> type, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
456      int argIndex = 0;
457      for (NodeIterator ni = c.iterator(); ni.hasNext();) {
458         E e = (E)readAnything(type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex++) : type.getElementType(), ni.next(), l, pMeta); // HTT: isArgs() requires method-argument list ClassMeta; not reachable through public parse() API.
459         l.add(e);
460      }
461      return l;
462   }
463
464   <E> Collection<E> readIntoCollection(RDFList list, Collection<E> l, ClassMeta<?> type, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
465      int argIndex = 0;
466      for (ExtendedIterator<RDFNode> ni = list.iterator(); ni.hasNext();) {
467         E e = (E)readAnything(type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex++) : type.getElementType(), ni.next(), l, pMeta); // HTT: isArgs() requires method-argument list ClassMeta; not reachable through public parse() API.
468         l.add(e);
469      }
470      return l;
471   }
472
473   <K,V> Map<K,V> readIntoMap(Resource r, Map<K,V> m, ClassMeta<K> keyType, ClassMeta<V> valueType, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
474      // Add URI as "uri" to generic maps.
475      if (nn(r.getURI())) {
476         var uri = convertAttrToType(m, "uri", keyType);
477         var value = convertAttrToType(m, r.getURI(), valueType);
478         m.put(uri, value);
479      }
480      for (StmtIterator i = r.listProperties(); i.hasNext();) {
481         var st = i.next();
482         var p = st.getPredicate();
483         var key = p.getLocalName();
484         if (! (key.equals("root") && p.getURI().equals(getJuneauNs().getUri()))) { // HTT: suspected bug — p.getURI() is the full property URI (namespace+"root"), never equal to the bare namespace URI on the right, so this AND-clause's true side is structurally unreachable; flagged, not fixed (see RdfParser_Test.L_streamSessionMoreCoverage#l27).
485            key = decodeString(key);
486            var o = st.getObject();
487            var key2 = convertAttrToType(m, key, keyType);
488            V value = readAnything(valueType, o, m, pMeta);
489            setName(valueType, value, key);
490            m.put(key2, value);
491         }
492
493      }
494      return m;
495   }

497   @SuppressWarnings({
498      "resource" // Resource management handled by InputStreamParserSession
499   })
500   @Override /* Overridden from InputStreamParserSession */
501   protected <T> T doRead(ParserPipe pipe, ClassMeta<T> type) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
502
503      RDFDataMgr.read(model, pipe.getInputStream(), lang);
504
505      var roots = getRoots(model);
506
507      // Special case where we're parsing a loose collection of resources.
508      if (isLooseCollections() && type.isCollectionOrArray()) { // HTT: RdfStreamParser.Builder only exposes language(); looseCollections is always false for stream parsers.
509         Collection c; // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
510         if (type.isArray() || type.isArgs()) // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
511            c = list(); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
512         else
513            c = (type.canCreateNewInstance(getOuter()) ? (Collection<?>)type.newInstance(getOuter()) : new JsonList(this)); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
514
515         var argIndex = new AtomicInteger(0); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
516         var c2 = c; // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
517         roots.forEach(x -> c2.add(readAnything(type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex.getAndIncrement()) : type.getElementType(), x, getOuter(), null))); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
518
519         if (type.isArray() || type.isArgs()) // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
520            return (T)toArray(type, c); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
521         return (T)c; // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
522      }
523
524      if (roots.isEmpty())
525         return type.isOptional() ? (T)oe() : null;
526
527      if (roots.size() > 1)
528         throw new ParseException(this, "Too many root nodes found in model:  %s", roots.size());
529      var resource = roots.get(0);
530
531      return readAnything(type, resource, getOuter(), null);
532   }
